newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Explosion on cargo ship near Hong Kong injures two.
newsitem.headline: Explosion on cargo ship near Hong Kong injures two.

text.p: Two crew members were injured in an explosion in the engine room of a Honduran-registered cargo ship off Hong Kong's Lamma Island, a government official said on Thursday.
"The injured members have been sent to the hospital on Wednesday night while the ship is now anchoring at the Southeast Lamma Anchorage," a marine department official said.
The Marine Star M, a 1,596 gross registered tonne general cargo vessel, which was allowed to enter Hong Kong following the accident, was awaiting its agent, he said.
The ship had been on its way from Shekou, in southern China, to Shanghai, according to a report from Lloyd's.
The Marine Department sent a survey team to the ship to investigate but the cause of the explosion, which took place late on Wednesday, was not immediately known.
